en: A sepia-toned photograph of a cobblestone street in a historical European city. The street is flanked by multi-story buildings with ornate facades and wrought iron signs extending from the upper stories. There are a few pedestrians walking along the street, and the scene appears calm and quiet. The architectural style and the street signs suggest a Central or Eastern European city. There is a number '26' written in red ink at the top and some faint white text.
